adjudication_summary: The original complete-message test correctly stopped before acceptance. This re-review reopened the local XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database evidence, repaired owner-layer database and final adjudication artifacts, preserved database conflicts instead of normalizing them away, and found no remaining blocking local material gap.

caution_findings.note: The primary source reports a modified two-component lantibiotic with dehydrations and proposed thioether bridges; database X-coded or plain residue strings are preserved with caution instead of being normalized into an exact modified structure.
dbAMP entry-level AntiGram-negative labels conflict with the primary Table 1 no-activity rows against tested Gram-negative bacteria.
No local primary toxicity or hemolysis assay was found; database no-data statements are retained as absence of evidence, not as safety evidence.
Text-reported thresholds, fold comparisons, and qualitative conclusions are curated; exact values embedded only in plotted images were not invented.
The local PDF supplements support MS/MS/structure and production-kinetics context; they do not add additional MIC, toxicity, or molecular-target tables beyond the article text.

non_negotiable_rules_applied: no acceptance from framework test or validator pass alone
no fabricated toxicity values or figure-only curve numbers
material_packet, validator_contract, semantic_gate, and publication_grade_review kept separate

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Functional synergy, sequential action, spore-outgrowth inhibition, and structural MS/MS evidence are source-located. No specific molecular target is promoted beyond the local evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains a separate layer: it has XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database evidence sufficient for owner-layer adjudication, while the material status label still records nonblocking extraction gaps.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: Open ticket rwk-complete-test-0001 is resolved by source-reviewed owner-layer repair; remaining cautions are nonblocking and explicit.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Required final review provenance, status fields, locators, and JSON contracts are present; validator readiness is not treated as scientific acceptance by itself.
